name: Poel (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Insel Poel (a white sailing ship on blue above a wheel-cross on green).
history: The arms were approved on 16 September 1993 and registered as no. 175 in the roll of arms of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the flag was approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 29 September 1993.

features.role: Poel arms — sailing ship and wheel-cross
